description: Boxing gyms and boxing clubs near a city, a ZIP or postal code, or the user's location: name, address, distance, the gym's own phone and website, Google Maps rating with its number of reviews, the programs its website names (kids / youth, women, boxing fitness, amateur, pro), federation club, notable boxers, a short description when one is written, and the boxerbook.com page of each gym and of its city. Answers "boxing gym near me", "where can I train boxing in Austin", "boxing classes for kids in Brooklyn", "best boxing gyms in Toronto", "boxing clubs in London" (the UK capital; London, Ontario is country CA) and "is there a boxing club near 10115", asked in any language. Give place (a city such as "Brooklyn", "Austin, TX" or "Manchester", a ZIP or postal code, a state or region, or a gym's name), or lat and lon when the user's location is known; need keeps the gyms with kids classes, women's classes, boxing fitness or competition boxing. A city lists its gyms with the most complete listings and the best-reviewed first, then the nearest around it; a point or a postal code lists them nearest first within radius_km. At most 20 gyms. The directory covers the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France and Switzerland (about 13,000 gyms); elsewhere the answer is empty and says so. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to keep to when a city name exists in several countries: US, CA, GB (UK), DE, FR or CH

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

lat.description: the user's latitude, when known and no place is named (used for this answer only, never stored)

need.description: only gyms with kids or youth classes (kids), women's classes (women), boxing fitness classes (fitness) or amateur / pro boxing (competition)

place.description: a city ("Brooklyn", "Austin, TX", "Toronto"), a ZIP or postal code ("11201", "M5V 2T6", "SW1A 1AA", "10115"), a state or region, or a gym's name; leave it out to search around lat and lon

radius_km.description: how far around the point, the postal code or the city centre to look, in km (10 mi = 16 km)

name: gyms_near

cite.description: the markdown link to quote with any fact of this answer: Source: [Boxerbook](<url of the main page>)

coverage.description: the countries of the gym directory

description.description: 2-3 sentences written from facts on the gym's own website or Wikipedia, when checked

distance.description: the same in miles (US) or km, for display

distance_km.description: from the point, postal code or city centre of the answer (distances_from), when the gym has coordinates

federation_club.description: listed in the national federation's club registry

notable_boxers.description: professional boxers the gym names, with their Boxerbook pages

phone.description: only a number the gym publishes itself

programs.description: programs named on the gym's own website: youth / kids classes, women's classes, boxing fitness, amateur boxing, professional boxing, Olympic-style boxing, kickboxing, MMA

verified_owner.description: the owner has verified the listing on Boxerbook

match.description: what the place was read as

other_places.description: other cities of that name, the cities of a region, or the nearest city with gyms

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

total.description: gyms on record for this place (and need); a city: its own gyms, plus every gym within radius_km of its centre when the city alone has fewer than limit (the area is read only then, to keep the answer to one statement)

url.description: the boxerbook.com page of the place (city, region, postal code search) or the gyms hub

title: Boxing gyms near a place
